verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents a server-side VerificationSession API (type=document), a Stripe-provided conversion-optimized capture flow with selfie matching, reusable flows with static hosted links, and result retrieval via the API and webhooks. Community users independently confirm the hosted UX, including desktop-to-phone handoff and in-browser image analysis, so developers do not build capture UI themselves. Missing for 10: explicit evidence in the pack of the redirect-URL versus embedded/modal integration mechanics.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself
